test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion loss and gradient computation using gtn forward_score and backward
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion loss and gradient computation using gtn compose and forward_score
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding using gtn viterbi_path on composed graphs
create_emissions_graph: create a GTN linear graph from an emissions vector with optional log probability conversion
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target sequence and blank label using gtn Graph
